test_title: PYST 45: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Salt of the earth

options.text: A very good and honest person
Discovered after a lot of searching

solution:
The correct answer is **A very good and honest person** .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Salt of the earth** is a **noun phrase**. A noun phrase is a combination of words that typically consists of a noun and a modifier, such as an adjective, adverb, or article, and which performs the same tasks as a **noun**.
 
• When you refer to someone as the salt of the earth, you are expressing your admiration for their ability to handle challenging or demanding circumstances without raising any additional issues.
 
• We can refer to a sentence as the example of the Salt of the earth.
 
 
• ***Example: **These students are the salt of the earth *
 
 
 
• The meaning of the above sentence is that the students are **good** and **honest **.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's see the meaning of the another option.
 
• The first option is **Do anything possible**. This **idiom** refers to do anything that is possible.
 
• The third option refers what was discovered after searching a lot.
 
• **Choose one at random** is a phrase that means to choose one thing in a** random** manner.
